name: TeamStarWolf - Thirty Days of Exposure Checks (KEV, October to November 2026) Case Study
description: Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques bound in the Thirty Days of Exposure Checks case study (KEV additions dated 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03 and the lab run of 3 and 4 November 2026). ATT&CK has no procedure that names these CVEs; each entry is the study's binding of a flaw's documented attack path to the technique definition. Score 100: a Confirmed record plus a lab-shown vulnerable version on a matched target. Score 75: a Confirmed record without a lab demonstration. Score 50: a Reported source or the study's own inference. Comments carry the study's source numbers. This is not an official MITRE mapping.

techniques.comment: ONLYOFFICE /upload traversal with RCE (NVD 2021-01-26); AhsayCBS CVE-2026-105133 and CVE-2026-105134, remote and unauthenticated (NVD 2026-10-04); Confluence CVE-2026-21589 unauthenticated file access (Atlassian 2026-10-05); WordPress CVE-2026-119977 unauthenticated upgrade race (GHSA 2026-10-29); Struts DMI RCE (NVD 2016-04-26). Lab showed the vulnerable version on matched ONLYOFFICE, AhsayCBS and WordPress targets, and the JWT precondition on ONLYOFFICE (2026-11-04, Demonstrated). Sources: [23]; [14]; [16]; [35]; [1]; [29]; [43]; [37].

BIND CVE-2015-5477 TKEY assertion failure and daemon exit (ISC 2015-07-28, NVD 2015-07-29, Confirmed); NetScaler CVE-2026-88779 CWE-119 (NVD 2026-10-04, binding Inferred). Lab blocked for both. Sources: [26]; [25]; [34]; [38].

Fragnesia CVE-2026-46300: low-privileged local attacker overwrites privileged binaries for root (Red Hat; oss-security 2026-05-13, Confirmed); SiteGuard CVE-2026-106931 AV:L/PR:L with commands as root (JVN 2026-10-14, binding Inferred). Sources: [8]; [7]; [10]; [12].

KEV: Fragnesia chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP web shells (2026-10-28, Confirmed); JSP web shells on AhsayCBS per Huntress (2026-10-07, Reported) and Horizon3 (Reported). Sources: [4]; [18]; [17].
SiteGuard CVE-2026-106931 OS command injection on the Apache and Nginx editions (JVN 2026-10-14); shell not named in the record, binding Inferred. Sources: [10]; [11].
XMRig miners placed on exploited AhsayCBS servers (Huntress, 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-08, Reported). Sources: [18].
XMRig miners on exploited AhsayCBS servers (Huntress, 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-08, Reported). Sources: [18].
Windows Shell CVE-2026-96951: a successful exploit evades Mark of the Web (Microsoft 2026-10-13, Confirmed). Lab host already at a fixed build. Sources: [20].
CVE-2026-96951: attacker sends a crafted file by email or instant message (Microsoft 2026-10-13, Confirmed). Sources: [20].
CVE-2026-96951: the user must click a link or open the file (Microsoft 2026-10-13, Confirmed). Sources: [20].
Confluence CVE-2026-21589 arbitrary file access with a known file name and path (Atlassian and NVD 2026-10-05); binding Inferred from CWE-552. Sources: [35]; [36].
The banner reads the lab used (version.bind, X-Powered-By, /identity, ajs-version-number) are the reads a scanner makes (lab 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-04); binding Inferred. Sources: [43].
